### Population change

Population data sources same as above.

```{r}
#| label: "population change"

pop1980 <- read.csv("../data/raw_data/cencounts.csv") %>%
  select(pop1980, name) %>%
  filter(str_starts(name, "ID") & name != "ID Idaho") %>%
  mutate(name = str_remove(name, "ID "),
         name = str_remove(name, " County"))

pop_change <- data.frame(county = c(pop1980$name,
                                    pop1990$name,
                                    pop2000$NAME,
                                    pop2010$NAME,
                                    pop2020$NAME),
                         year = rep(seq(1980, 2020, 10), each = nrow(pop1990)),
                         pop = as.numeric(c(pop1980$pop1980,
                                 pop1990$pop1990,
                                 pop2000$value,
                                 pop2010$value,
                                 pop2020$value))) %>%
  arrange(county, year) %>%
  mutate(pop_prev = lag(pop, 1),
         pop_change = pop - pop_prev,
         perc_pop_change = pop_change / pop_prev * 100) %>%
  filter(year %in% c(1990,2000,2010,2020)) %>%
  select(county, year, perc_pop_change)

# join
a_data <- left_join(a_data, pop_change, by = c("county", "year"))
```

## A2 -- Socioeconomic attributes

### Employment sectors

County Business Patterns reports private sector employment, but they sometimes add missing values for confidentiality. We used imputed missing values for 1997-2012 from:

Fabian Eckert, Teresa C. Fort, Peter K. Schott, and Natalie J. Yang. "Imputing Missing Values in the US Census Bureau's County Business Patterns." NBER Working Paper #26632, 2021. https://www.fpeckert.me/cbp/

2022 County Business Patterns data was downloaded with the `censusapi` package. SIC and NAICS codes were referenced here: https://www.census.gov/programs-surveys/cbp/technical-documentation/reference/naics-descriptions.html

```{r}
         "county" = "fipscty")

loc_emp_1997_labs <- read.table("../data/raw_data/employment/97CEMPID.DAT",
                                sep = ";", comment.char = "", quote = "") %>%
  filter(str_starts(V1, "13")) %>%
  mutate(id = substr(V1, 1, 14),
         GEOID = substr(V1, 110, 114)) %>%
  select(-V1)
loc_emp_1997 <- read_table("../data/raw_data/employment/97CEMPST.DAT",
                           na = "999999999",
                           col_names = c("id", "gov_func_code", "full_time_emp", "full_time_payroll", "part_time_emp", "part_time_payroll", "part_time_hours", "full_time_equivalent_emp")) %>%
  filter(str_starts(id, "13")) %>%
  left_join(loc_emp_1997_labs) %>%
  filter(gov_func_code %in% c("025", "079", "032", "040", "061", "050", "012", "112", "052") & GEOID != "16   ") %>%
  mutate(gov_func = factor(gov_func_code, 
                           levels = c("025", "079", "032", "040", "061", "050", "012", "112", "052"),
                           labels = c("Judicial & Legal", "Public Welfare", "Health", "Hospitals", "Parks & Recreation", "Housing & Community Development", "Education - Elementary and Secondary Instructional", "Education - Elementary and Secondary Other", "Libraries"))) %>%
  mutate(Industry = ifelse(gov_func == "Judicial & Legal", "Legal", NA),
         Industry = ifelse(gov_func %in% c("Libraries", "Education - Elementary and Secondary Instructional", "Education - Elementary and Secondary Other"), "Education and Libraries", Industry),
         Industry = ifelse(gov_func %in% c("Health", "Hospitals", "Housing & Community Development", "Public Welfare"), "Health and Social Services", Industry),
         Industry = ifelse(gov_func == "Parks & Recreation", "Recreation", Industry)) %>%
  group_by(GEOID, Industry) %>%
  summarise(employed = sum(full_time_emp, part_time_emp, na.rm=TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(year = 1997)

loc_emp_2002_labs <- read.table("../data/raw_data/employment/02cempid.dat",
                                sep = ";", comment.char = "", quote = "") %>%
  filter(str_starts(V1, "13")) %>%
  mutate(id = substr(V1, 1, 14),
         GEOID = substr(V1, 110, 114)) %>%
  select(-V1)

                           levels = c("025", "079", "032", "040", "061", "050", "012", "112", "052"),
                           labels = c("Judicial & Legal", "Public Welfare", "Health", "Hospitals", "Parks & Recreation", "Housing & Community Development", "Education - Elementary and Secondary Instructional", "Education - Elementary and Secondary Other", "Libraries"))) %>%
  mutate(Industry = ifelse(gov_func == "Judicial & Legal", "Legal", NA),
         Industry = ifelse(gov_func %in% c("Libraries", "Education - Elementary and Secondary Instructional", "Education - Elementary and Secondary Other"), "Education and Libraries", Industry),
         Industry = ifelse(gov_func %in% c("Health", "Hospitals", "Housing & Community Development", "Public Welfare"), "Health and Social Services", Industry),
         Industry = ifelse(gov_func == "Parks & Recreation", "Recreation", Industry)) %>%

loc_emp_2012_labs <- read.table("../data/raw_data/employment/12cempid.dat",
                                sep = ";", comment.char = "", quote = "") %>%
  filter(str_starts(V1, "13")) %>%
  mutate(id = substr(V1, 1, 14),
         GEOID = substr(V1, 110, 114)) %>%

loc_emp_2012 <- read_table("../data/raw_data/employment/12cempst.dat",
                           col_names = c("id", "gov_func_code", "full_time_emp", "full_time_emp_flag", "full_time_payroll", "full_time_payroll_flag", "part_time_emp", "part_time_emp_flag", "part_time_payroll", "part_time_payroll_flag", "part_time_hours", "part_time_hours_flag", "full_time_equivalent_emp")) %>%
  filter(str_starts(id, "13")) %>%
  left_join(loc_emp_2012_labs) %>%
  filter(gov_func_code %in% c("025", "079", "032", "040", "061", "050", "012", "112", "052") & GEOID != "16   ") %>%
  mutate(gov_func = factor(gov_func_code, 
                           levels = c("025", "079", "032", "040", "061", "050", "012", "112", "052"),
                           labels = c("Judicial & Legal", "Public Welfare", "Health", "Hospitals", "Parks & Recreation", "Housing & Community Development", "Education - Elementary and Secondary Instructional", "Education - Elementary and Secondary Other", "Libraries"))) %>%
  mutate(Industry = ifelse(gov_func == "Judicial & Legal", "Legal", NA),
         Industry = ifelse(gov_func %in% c("Libraries", "Education - Elementary and Secondary Instructional", "Education - Elementary and Secondary Other"), "Education and Libraries", Industry),
         Industry = ifelse(gov_func %in% c("Health", "Hospitals", "Housing & Community Development", "Public Welfare"), "Health and Social Services", Industry),
         Industry = ifelse(gov_func == "Parks & Recreation", "Recreation", Industry)) %>%
  group_by(GEOID, Industry) %>%
  summarise(employed = sum(full_time_emp, part_time_emp)) %>%
  mutate(year = 2012)

loc_emp_2022 <- readxl::read_xlsx("../data/raw_data/employment/22emp.xlsx",
                                  col_types = c("text", "text", "text", "text", "numeric", "skip", "skip", "skip", "numeric", "skip", "skip", "skip", "text", "skip", "text", "text", "text", "skip", "skip", "skip", "skip", "skip", "skip")) %>%
  filter(State == "Idaho" & !is.na(`FIPS County`)) %>%
  filter(`Government Function` %in% c("Health", "Hospitals", "Judicial and Legal", "Libraries", "Education - Elementary and Secondary Instructional", "Education - Elementary and Secondary Other", "Housing and Community Development", "Parks and Recreation", "Public Welfare")) %>%
  mutate(Industry = ifelse(`Government Function` == "Judicial and Legal", "Legal", NA),
         Industry = ifelse(`Government Function` %in% c("Libraries", "Education - Elementary and Secondary Instructional", "Education - Elementary and Secondary Other"), "Education and Libraries", Industry),
         Industry = ifelse(`Government Function` %in% c("Health", "Hospitals", "Housing and Community Development", "Public Welfare"), "Health and Social Services", Industry),
         Industry = ifelse(`Government Function` == "Parks and Recreation", "Recreation", Industry)) %>%
  group_by(`FIPS State`, `FIPS County`, Industry) %>%
  summarise(employed = sum(`Full-time Employees`, `Part-time Employees`)) %>%
  mutate(year = 2022,
         GEOID = paste0(`FIPS State`, `FIPS County`)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(GEOID, year, Industry, employed)

fed_state <- readxl::read_xlsx("../data/raw_data/employment/allhlcn97.xlsx") %>%
  rbind(readxl::read_xlsx("../data/raw_data/employment/allhlcn02.xlsx")) %>%
  rbind(readxl::read_xlsx("../data/raw_data/employment/allhlcn12.xlsx")) %>%
  rbind(readxl::read_xlsx("../data/raw_data/employment/allhlcn22.xlsx")) %>%
  filter(`St Name` == "Idaho" & Ownership %in% c("Federal Government", "State Government")) %>%
  select(`Area\r\nCode`, Year, Ownership, `Annual Average Employment`) %>%
  rename("GEOID" = "Area\r\nCode",
         "year" = "Year",
         "Industry" = "Ownership",
         "employed" = "Annual Average Employment") %>%
  mutate(year = as.integer(year))

producers <- nassqs(list(state_alpha = "ID",
                         agg_level_desc = "county",
                         year = c(1997, 2002, 2012, 2022),
                         short_desc = c("Operators, principal, primary occupation, (excl farming) - number of operators",
                                        "Operators, principal, primary occupation, farming - number of operators",
                                        "Producers, primary occupation, (excl farming) - number of producers",
                                        "Producers, primary occupation, farming - number of producers"))) %>%
  mutate(GEOID = paste0(state_fips_code, county_code)) %>%
  group_by(GEOID, year) %>%
  summarise(employed = sum(Value)) %>%
  mutate(Industry = "Agriculture, Forestry, Fishing and Hunting",
         year = as.integer(year))

## add total employed
cbp_totals <- employment %>%
  mutate(county = str_pad(county, width=3, side="left", pad="0"),
         GEOID = paste0(state, county)) %>%
  group_by(GEOID, year) %>%
  summarise(total_employed = sum(emp)) %>%
  rbind(employment2022 %>%
          filter(NAICS2017 == "00") %>%
          mutate(GEOID = paste0(state, county),
                 year=2022) %>%
          rename("total_employed" = "EMP") %>%
          select(GEOID, year, total_employed))

  group_by(GEOID, year) %>%
  summarise(total_employed = sum(employed))

  group_by(GEOID, year) %>%
  summarise(total_employed = sum(employed))
producers_totals <- producers %>%
  group_by(GEOID, year) %>%
  summarise(total_employed = sum(employed))

employment_totals <- rbind(cbp_totals, loc_emp_totals, fed_state_totals, producers_totals) %>%
  group_by(GEOID, year) %>%
  summarise(total_employed = sum(total_employed)) %>%
  mutate(county = recode(GEOID, !!!GEOID_names))

employment_clean <- employment %>%
  mutate(county = str_pad(county, width=3, side="left", pad="0"),
         GEOID = paste0(state, county),
         industry_matches = ifelse(naics12 %in% employment_codes$naics12, naics12, NA)) %>%
  mutate(industry_matches = ifelse(str_sub(naics12, 1, 4) %in% employment_codes$naics12, str_sub(naics12, 1, 4), industry_matches)) %>%
  mutate(industry_matches = ifelse(str_sub(naics12, 1, 3) %in% employment_codes$naics12, str_sub(naics12, 1, 3), industry_matches)) %>%
  mutate(industry_matches = ifelse(str_sub(naics12, 1, 2) %in% employment_codes$naics12, str_sub(naics12, 1, 2), industry_matches)) %>%
  mutate(Industry = recode_factor(industry_matches, !!!recode_naic12)) %>%
  filter(Industry %in% employment_codes$sector) %>%
  group_by(GEOID, year, Industry) %>%
  summarise(employed = sum(emp)) %>%
  rbind(loc_emp_1997) %>%
  rbind(loc_emp_2002) %>%
  rbind(loc_emp_2012) %>%
  rbind(filter(fed_state, year != 2022)) %>%
  rbind(filter(producers, year != 2022)) %>%
  mutate(county = recode(GEOID, !!!GEOID_names), county) %>%
  group_by(county, year, Industry) %>%
  summarise(employed = sum(employed)) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c("county", "year"),
              names_from = "Industry",
              values_from = "employed") %>%
  filter(county != 16999 & county != 16000) %>%
  replace(is.na(.), 0) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  # mutate(Total = rowSums(.[3:ncol(.)])) %>%
  left_join(employment_totals[,-1], by = c("county", "year")) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(across(!c(county, year),
                ~.x/total_employed * 100)) %>%
  select(-total_employed)
  

employment2022_clean <- employment2022 %>%
  mutate(GEOID = paste0(state, county),
         year=2022,
         NAICS2017 = str_remove_all(NAICS2017, " "),
         Industry = recode_factor(NAICS2017, !!!recode_naic22)) %>%
  filter(Industry %in% employment_codes$sector) %>%
  group_by(GEOID, year, Industry) %>%
  summarise(employed = sum(EMP)) %>%
  rbind(loc_emp_2022) %>%
  rbind(filter(fed_state, year == 2022)) %>%
  rbind(filter(producers, year == 2022)) %>%
  mutate(county = recode(GEOID, !!!GEOID_names), county) %>%
  group_by(county, year, Industry) %>%
  summarise(employed = sum(employed)) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c("county", "year"),
              names_from = "Industry",
              values_from = "employed") %>%
  filter(county != 16999 & county != 16000) %>%
  select(-Total) %>%
  replace(is.na(.), 0) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  # mutate(Total = rowSums(.[3:ncol(.)])) %>%
  left_join(employment_totals[,-1], by = c("county", "year")) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(across(!c(county, year),
                ~.x/total_employed * 100)) %>%
  select(-total_employed)

# employment_industries <- rbind(employment_industries, employment2022_clean)
# employment_industries_update <- rbind(employment_clean, employment2022_clean)
employment_industries_update_new_totals <- rbind(employment_clean, employment2022_clean)

employ_pca <- prcomp(employment_industries_update_new_totals[,-c(1:2)])
summary(employ_pca)
#biplot(employ_pca)

# join components explaining >70% of variance
a_data <- cbind(employment_industries_update_new_totals, employ_pca$x[,1:4]) %>%
  select(county, year, PC1, PC2, PC3, PC4) %>%
  rename("emply_pc1" = "PC1",
         "emply_pc2" = "PC2",
         "emply_pc3" = "PC3",
         "emply_pc4" = "PC4") %>%
  mutate(year = ifelse(year == 1997, 1990, year-2)) %>%
  right_join(a_data, by=c("county", "year"))
```

### Percent population 65+ not in labor force (retired)

Data for 2000-2020 were downloaded via API call using `tidycensus`. Data from 1990 was digitized from Table 144 of the 1990 Census of Population for Idaho (https://www2.census.gov/library/publications/decennial/1990/cp-2/cp-2-14.pdf).

```{r}
#| label: "percent retired"

retired1990 <- read.csv("../data/1990_US_Census_data.csv") %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(perc_retired = sum(Males_65_69_not_in_labor_force,
                            Males_70plus_not_in_labor_force,
                            Females_65_69_not_in_labor_force,
                            Females_70plus_not_in_labor_force) /
           sum(Pop_urban, Pop_rural) * 100) %>%
  rename("county" = "County",
         "year" = "Year") %>%
  select(county, year, perc_retired)

retired2000 <- get_decennial(geography = "county",
                             table = "PCT035",
                             year = 2000,
                             state = "ID") %>%
  filter(variable %in% c("PCT035001", "PCT035079", "PCT035086", "PCT035093", "PCT035171", "PCT035178", "PCT035185")) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c("GEOID", "NAME"),
              names_from = "variable",
              values_from = "value") %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(perc_retired = sum(PCT035079, PCT035086, PCT035093, PCT035171, PCT035178, PCT035185) / PCT035001 * 100) %>%
  mutate(county = str_remove(NAME, " County, Idaho"),
         year = 2000) %>%
  select(county, year, perc_retired)

retired2010 <- get_acs(geography = "county",
                       table = "B23001",
                       year = 2010,
                       state = "ID") %>%
  filter(variable %in% c("B23001_001", "B23001_077", "B23001_082", "B23001_087", "B23001_163", "B23001_168", "B23001_173")) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c("GEOID", "NAME"),
              names_from = "variable",
              values_from = "estimate") %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(perc_retired = sum(B23001_077, B23001_082, B23001_087, B23001_163, B23001_168, B23001_173) / B23001_001 * 100) %>%
  mutate(county = str_remove(NAME, " County, Idaho"),
         year = 2010) %>%
  select(county, year, perc_retired)

retired2020 <- get_acs(geography = "county",
                       table = "B23001",
                       year = 2020,
                       state = "ID") %>%
  filter(variable %in% c("B23001_001", "B23001_077", "B23001_082", "B23001_087", "B23001_163", "B23001_168", "B23001_173")) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c("GEOID", "NAME"),
              names_from = "variable",
              values_from = "estimate") %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(perc_retired = sum(B23001_077, B23001_082, B23001_087, B23001_163, B23001_168, B23001_173) / B23001_001 * 100) %>%
  mutate(county = str_remove(NAME, " County, Idaho"),
         year = 2020) %>%
  select(county, year, perc_retired)

a_data <- rbind(retired1990, retired2000, retired2010, retired2020) %>%
  right_join(a_data, by = c("county", "year"))
```

### Average age

Age data downloaded from https://seer.cancer.gov/popdata/download.html.

```{r}
#| label: "average age"

age_raw <- read.table(file = gzfile("../data/raw_data/id.1969_2023.singleages.through89.90plus.txt.gz"),
                      sep = "\n", strip.white = TRUE)

age_formatted <- age_raw %>%
  mutate(year = as.integer(substr(V1, 1, 4)),
         GEOID = substr(V1, 7, 11),
         Age = as.numeric(substr(V1, 17, 18)),
         Pop = as.numeric(substr(V1, 19, 19+8)))

age <- age_formatted %>%
  filter(year %in% c(1990, 2000, 2010, 2020)) %>%
  mutate(county = recode(GEOID, !!!GEOID_names)) %>%
  group_by(county, year) %>%
  summarise(avg_age = weighted.mean(Age, Pop))

a_data <- left_join(a_data, age, by = c("county", "year"))
```

### Median household income

Data for 2000-2020 were downloaded via API call using `tidycensus`. Data from 1990 were digitized from Table 148 in the 1990 Census of Population Idaho (https://www2.census.gov/library/publications/decennial/1990/cp-2/cp-2-14.pdf).

Consumer price indices were retrieved from the Bureau of Labor Statistics (https://download.bls.gov/pub/time.series/cu/cu.data.1.AllItems). I used the All Items CPI-U for the West region of the US. (series ID = CUUR0400SA0; Time series information here: https://download.bls.gov/pub/time.series/cu/)

```{r}
#| label: "median income"

# to adjust for inflation, we need the consumer price index for each year
cpiu_general_west_dec_1990 <- 135
cpiu_general_west_dec_2000 <- 177.1
cpiu_general_west_dec_2010 <- 222.081
cpiu_general_west_dec_2020 <- 276.593

medinc1990 <- read.csv("../data/1990_US_Census_data.csv") %>%
  rename("county" = "County",
         "year" = "Year",
         "med_income" = "Median_household_income") %>%
  mutate(cpiu = cpiu_general_west_dec_1990) %>%
  select(county, year, med_income, cpiu)

medinc2000 <- get_decennial(geography = "county",
                            variables = "P053001",
                            year = 2000,
                            state = "ID") %>%
  mutate(county = str_remove(NAME, " County, Idaho"),
         year = 2000,
         cpiu = cpiu_general_west_dec_2000) %>%
  rename("med_income" = "value") %>%
  select(county, year, med_income, cpiu)

medinc2010 <- get_acs(geography = "county",
                      variables = "B19013_001",
                      year = 2010,
                      state = "ID") %>%
  mutate(county = str_remove(NAME, " County, Idaho"),
         year = 2010,
         cpiu = cpiu_general_west_dec_2010) %>%
  rename("med_income" = "estimate") %>%
  select(county, year, med_income, cpiu)

medinc2020 <- get_acs(geography = "county",
                      variables = "B19013_001",
                      year = 2020,
                      state = "ID") %>%
  mutate(county = str_remove(NAME, " County, Idaho"),
         year = 2020,
         cpiu = cpiu_general_west_dec_2020) %>%
  rename("med_income" = "estimate") %>%
  select(county, year, med_income, cpiu)

medinc <- rbind(medinc1990, medinc2000, medinc2010, medinc2020) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(cpiu_ratio = cpiu_general_west_dec_2020 / cpiu,
         med_income_in_2020_USD = med_income * cpiu_ratio) %>%
  select(county, year, med_income_in_2020_USD)

a_data <- left_join(a_data, medinc, by = c("county", "year"))
```

### Employment rate

Raw unemployment data was downloaded from https://download.bls.gov/pub/time.series/la/ (`la.data.64.County`).

```{r}
unemployment_raw <- read.table(file = gzfile("../data/raw_data/la.data.64.County.txt.gz"),
                               header = TRUE,
                               sep = "\t")

unemployment_clean <- unemployment_raw %>%
  filter(str_detect(series_id, "0000000003") &
           year %in% c(1990, 2000, 2010, 2020)) %>%
  mutate(value = as.numeric(value),
         GEOID = substr(series_id, 6, 10)) %>%
  filter(str_starts(GEOID, "16")) %>%
  group_by(GEOID, year) %>%
  summarise(unemployment_rate = mean(value)) %>%
  mutate(county = recode(GEOID, !!!GEOID_names)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(county, year, unemployment_rate)

# join
a_data <- left_join(a_data, unemployment_clean, by = c("county", "year"))
```

### Education level

Data for 2000-2020 were downloaded via API call using `tidycensus`. Data from 1990 were downloaded from IPUMS:
Steven Manson, Jonathan Schroeder, David Van Riper, Katherine Knowles, Tracy Kugler, Finn Roberts, and Steven Ruggles. IPUMS National Historical Geographic Information System: Version 19.0 [dataset]. Minneapolis, MN: IPUMS. 2024. http://doi.org/10.18128/D050.V19.0

Population data for 2000-2020 were downloaded via `tidycensus`. Data for 1990 were downloaded from https://www.nber.org/research/data/census-us-decennial-county-population-data-1900-1990.

```{r}
#| label: "education level"

educ1990 <- read.csv("../data/raw_data/nhgis0009_csv/nhgis0009_ds123_1990_county.csv") %>%
  filter(STUSAB == "ID") %>%
  rename("county" = "COUNTY",
         "year" = "YEAR",
         "high_school" = "E33003",
         "bachelors" = "E33006") %>%
  select(county, year, high_school, bachelors)

educ2000 <- get_decennial(geography = "county",
                          variables = c("P037011", "P037015", "P037028", "P037032"),
                          year = 2000,
                          state = "ID",
                          sumfile = "sf3") %>%
  mutate(county = str_remove(NAME, " County, Idaho"),
         year = 2000,
         variable = ifelse(variable %in% c("P037011", "P037028"), "high_school", "bachelors")) %>%
  group_by(county, year, variable) %>%
  summarise(value = sum(value)) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c("county", "year"),
              names_from = variable,
              values_from = value) %>%
  select(county, year, high_school, bachelors)

educ2010 <- get_acs(geography = "county",
                      variables = c("B06009_003", "B06009_005"),
                      year = 2010,
                      state = "ID",
                      survey="acs5") %>%
  mutate(county = str_remove(NAME, " County, Idaho"),
         year = 2010,
         variable = ifelse(variable == "B06009_003", "high_school", "bachelors")) %>%
  group_by(county, year, variable) %>%
  summarise(estimate = sum(estimate)) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c("county", "year"),
              names_from = variable,
              values_from = estimate) %>%
  select(county, year, high_school, bachelors)

educ2020 <- get_acs(geography = "county",
                      variables = c("B06009_003", "B06009_005"),
                      year = 2020,
                      state = "ID",
                      survey="acs5") %>%
  mutate(county = str_remove(NAME, " County, Idaho"),
         year = 2020,
         variable = ifelse(variable == "B06009_003", "high_school", "bachelors")) %>%
  group_by(county, year, variable) %>%
  summarise(estimate = sum(estimate)) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c("county", "year"),
              names_from = variable,
              values_from = estimate) %>%
  select(county, year, high_school, bachelors)

educ_level <- rbind(educ1990, educ2000, educ2010, educ2020)

pop1990 <- read.csv("../data/raw_data/cencounts.csv") %>%
  select(pop1990, name) %>%
  filter(str_starts(name, "ID") & name != "ID Idaho") %>%
  mutate(name = str_remove(name, "ID "),
         name = str_remove(name, " County"))
pop2000 <- get_decennial(geography = "county",
                        state = "ID",
                        variables = "P001001",
                        year = 2000) %>%
  mutate(NAME = str_remove(NAME, " County, Idaho"))
pop2010 <- get_decennial(geography = "county",
                        state = "ID",
                        variables = "P001001",
                        year = 2010) %>%
  mutate(NAME = str_remove(NAME, " County, Idaho"))
pop2020 <- get_decennial(geography = "county",
                        state = "ID",
                        variables = "P1_001N",
                        year = 2020) %>%
  mutate(NAME = str_remove(NAME, " County, Idaho"))
pop_tot <- data.frame(county = c(pop1990$name,
                                  pop2000$NAME,
                                  pop2010$NAME,
                                  pop2020$NAME),
                            year = rep(seq(1990, 2020, 10), each = nrow(pop1990)),
                            pop = as.numeric(c(pop1990$pop1990,
                                    pop2000$value,
                                    pop2010$value,
                                    pop2020$value)))

educ_level <- left_join(educ_level, pop_tot) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(high_school = high_school/pop * 100,
         bachelors = bachelors/pop * 100)

# join
a_data <- left_join(a_data, edu_level, by = c("county", "year"))
```

### Racial Composition

Data for 2000-2020 were downloaded via API call using `tidycensus`. Data for 1990 were digitized from Table 6 in the 1990 Census of Population (https://www2.census.gov/library/publications/decennial/1990/cp-2/cp-2-14.pdf).

```{r}
#| label: "racial composition"

races1990 <- read.csv("../data/1990_US_Census_data.csv") %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(across(Persons_white:Persons_other, ~.x / sum(Pop_urban, Pop_rural) * 100)) %>%
  rename("county" = "County",
         "year" = "Year") %>%
  select(county, year, Persons_AmericanIndian_Eskimo_Aleut, Persons_Asian, Persons_Black, Persons_PacificIslander, Persons_other, Persons_white)

races2000 <- get_decennial(geography = "county",
                           table = "P003",
                           year = 2000,
                           state = "ID") %>%
  mutate(variable = str_replace(variable, "P003001", "Total"),
         variable = str_replace(variable, "P003003", "Persons_white"),
         variable = str_replace(variable, "P003004", "Persons_Black"),
         variable = str_replace(variable, "P003005", "Persons_AmericanIndian_Eskimo_Aleut"),
         variable = str_replace(variable, "P003006", "Persons_Asian"),
         variable = str_replace(variable, "P003007", "Persons_PacificIslander"),
         variable = str_replace(variable, "P003008", "Persons_other"),
         variable = str_replace(variable, "P003009", "Persons_other"),
         county = str_remove(NAME, " County, Idaho")) %>%
  group_by(county, variable) %>%
  summarise(value = sum(value)) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = "county",
              names_from = "variable",
              values_from = "value") %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(across(Persons_AmericanIndian_Eskimo_Aleut:Persons_white,
                ~.x / Total * 100)) %>%
  mutate(year = 2000) %>%
  select(county, year, Persons_AmericanIndian_Eskimo_Aleut:Persons_white)

races2010 <- get_decennial(geography = "county",
                           table = "P003",
                           year = 2010,
                           state = "ID") %>%
  mutate(variable = str_replace(variable, "P003001", "Total"),
         variable = str_replace(variable, "P003002", "Persons_white"),
         variable = str_replace(variable, "P003003", "Persons_Black"),
         variable = str_replace(variable, "P003004", "Persons_AmericanIndian_Eskimo_Aleut"),
         variable = str_replace(variable, "P003005", "Persons_Asian"),
         variable = str_replace(variable, "P003006", "Persons_PacificIslander"),
         variable = str_replace(variable, "P003007", "Persons_other"),
         variable = str_replace(variable, "P003008", "Persons_other"),
         county = str_remove(NAME, " County, Idaho")) %>%
  group_by(county, variable) %>%
  summarise(value = sum(value)) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = "county",
              names_from = "variable",
              values_from = "value") %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(across(Persons_AmericanIndian_Eskimo_Aleut:Persons_white,
                ~.x / Total * 100)) %>%
  mutate(year = 2010) %>%
  select(county, year, Persons_AmericanIndian_Eskimo_Aleut:Persons_white)

races2020 <- get_decennial(geography = "county",
                           table = "P3",
                           year = 2020,
                           state = "ID",
                           sumfile = "dhc") %>%
  mutate(variable = str_replace(variable, "P3_001N", "Total"),
         variable = str_replace(variable, "P3_002N", "Persons_white"),
         variable = str_replace(variable, "P3_003N", "Persons_Black"),
         variable = str_replace(variable, "P3_004N", "Persons_AmericanIndian_Eskimo_Aleut"),
         variable = str_replace(variable, "P3_005N", "Persons_Asian"),
         variable = str_replace(variable, "P3_006N", "Persons_PacificIslander"),
         variable = str_replace(variable, "P3_007N", "Persons_other"),
         variable = str_replace(variable, "P3_008N", "Persons_other"),
         county = str_remove(NAME, " County, Idaho")) %>%
  group_by(county, variable) %>%
  summarise(value = sum(value)) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = "county",
              names_from = "variable",
              values_from = "value") %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(across(Persons_AmericanIndian_Eskimo_Aleut:Persons_white,
                ~.x / Total * 100)) %>%
  mutate(year = 2020) %>%
  select(county, year, Persons_AmericanIndian_Eskimo_Aleut:Persons_white)

races_all <- rbind(races1990, races2000, races2010, races2020)

races_pca <- prcomp(races_all[,-c(1:2)])

races_pc_results <- cbind(races_all[,c("county", "year")], races_pca$x[, "PC1"]) %>%
  rename("races_PC1" = 'races_pca$x[, "PC1"]')

a_data <- left_join(a_data, races_pc_results, by = c("county", "year"))
```

### Agriculture

#### Farm ownership

Percent of farms full-owned, part-owned, or tenant operated. We use PCA scores since these percentages add to 100%. 1990 data are from https://agcensus.library.cornell.edu/census_parts/1992-idaho/, Chapter 2, Table 11.

```{r}
#| label: "farm tenure"

params <- list(agg_level_desc = "county",
               state_name = "Idaho",
               year = c(2002, 2012, 2022),
               commodity_desc = "Farm operations",
               short_desc = "Farm operations - number of operations",
               domain_desc = "tenure")
# retrieve and clean
farm_own <- nassqs(params)
# save a backup copy
# write.csv(farm_own,
#           "../data/API_data_download_backup/farm_own.csv",
#           row.names = FALSE)

farm_own_perc <- farm_own %>%
  select(county_name, year, Value, domaincat_desc) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = county_name:year,
              names_from = domaincat_desc,
              values_from = Value) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(total_farms = sum(c_across(`TENURE: (FULL OWNER)`:`TENURE: (TENANT)`))) %>%
  mutate(across(`TENURE: (FULL OWNER)`:`TENURE: (TENANT)`,
                ~.x / total_farms * 100)) %>%
  rename("Num_full_owned" = "TENURE: (FULL OWNER)",
         "Num_part_owned" = "TENURE: (PART OWNER)",
         "Num_tenant" = "TENURE: (TENANT)",
         "county" = "county_name") %>%
  select(-total_farms)

farm_tenure_1992 <- read.csv("../data/1992_CensOfAg_data.csv") %>%
  left_join(read.csv("../data/Farm_size_1925-1992.csv")) %>%
  filter(Size == "all farms") %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with("Num_"), ~.x/Num_farms * 100)) %>%
  rename("county" = "County",
         "year" = "Year") %>%
  select(county, year, Num_full_owned:Num_tenant)

#combine
farm_own_perc <- rbind(farm_own_perc, farm_tenure_1992) %>%
  na.omit()



# for categories that add to 1, add PCA components to clustering data
farm_own_pca <- prcomp(farm_own_perc[,3:5])

# join
a_data <- farm_own_perc %>%
  cbind(., farm_own_pca$x[,1]) %>% # adding components that explain >90% of variance
  rename('tenure_pc1' = 'farm_own_pca$x[, 1]') %>%
  select(county, year, tenure_pc1) %>%
  mutate(county = str_to_title(county),
         year = as.integer(year)-2) %>%
  left_join(a_data, .)
```

#### Farms with net loss

Data for 2002-2022 were downloaded from the NASS API. Data for 1992 were digitized from https://agcensus.library.cornell.edu/census_parts/1992-idaho/, Chapter 2, Table 4.

```{r}
#| label: "farms with loss - actors"

params <- list(agg_level_desc = "county",
               state_name = "Idaho",
               year = c(2002, 2012, 2022),
               short_desc = c("Income, net cash farm, of operations - operations with loss",
                              "Farm operations - number of operations"),
               domain_desc = "total")

farms_w_loss <- nassqs(params)

farms_w_loss_1992 <- read.csv("../data/1992_CensOfAg_data.csv") %>%
  left_join(read.csv("../data/Farm_size_1925-1992.csv")) %>%
  filter(Size == "all farms") %>%
  mutate(perc_farms_w_net_loss = Farms_w_net_losses / Num_farms * 100) %>%
  rename("county" = "County",
         "year" = "Year") %>%
  mutate(year = as.numeric(year-2)) %>%
  select(county, year, perc_farms_w_net_loss)

# clean and join
a_data <- farms_w_loss %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c(county_name, year),
              names_from = statisticcat_desc,
              values_from = Value) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(perc_farms_w_net_loss = `LOSS` / `OPERATIONS` * 100) %>%
  rename("county" = "county_name") %>%
  mutate(county = str_to_title(county),
         year = as.numeric(year)-2) %>%
  select(c(county, year, perc_farms_w_net_loss)) %>%
  rbind(farms_w_loss_1992) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  right_join(a_data, by=c("county", "year"))
```

```{r}
hired1990 <- read.csv("../data/1992_CensOfAg_data.csv") %>%

params <- list(agg_level_desc = "county",
               state_name = "Idaho",

hired <- nassqs(params)

hired_clean <- hired %>%
  mutate(county_name = str_to_title(county_name),

  rename("county" = "county_name") %>%
  rbind(hired1990)

a_data <- left_join(a_data, hired_clean, by = c("county", "year"))
```


## A4 -- Location

### Population in urban and rural areas

Use RUCA counts instead? https://www.ers.usda.gov/data-products/rural-urban-commuting-area-codes and paper that uses it: https://doi.org/10.1111/ruso.70012

RUCA codes are a proxy for geographic isolation

RUCA codes are not comparable across years.

United States Department of Commerce, Bureau of the Census (1990). Census
Transportation Planning Package (CTPP) 1990: Urban Element: Parts 1, 2, and 3
[datasets]. United States Department of Transportation, Bureau of Transportation
Statistics [distributor] https://doi.org/10.21949/1524186

RUCA is made of two items at the tract level: presence in a metropolitan, micropolitan, small town, or rural area and commuting flows to these types of areas. Unfortunately, 1990 data is only available statewide at the county level, so I have modified this measure for the county level.

Data for [1990](https://www.census.gov/data/datasets/1990/demo/commuting/worker-flow.html), [2000](https://www.census.gov/data/tables/2000/dec/county-to-county-worker-flow-files.html), [2010](https://www.census.gov/data/tables/2010/demo/metro-micro/commuting-employment-2010.html), and [2020](https://www.census.gov/data/tables/2020/demo/metro-micro/commuting-flows-2020.html)

```{r}
#| label: "urban rural pop"

# label counties by urbanicity

us_counties <- tigris::counties()

id_buff <- st_union(county_shapes) %>% st_buffer(units::set_units(150, "mi"))
  
near_counties <- st_filter(us_counties, id_buff, .predicate = st_covered_by)

# get block data from urban land code chunk

years <- seq(1990, 2020, 10)
counties_urb <- mapply(function(blocks, year) {
  UAs <- st_read(paste0("../data/urb_areas_thresholded/urb_areas_thresholded_", year, ".shp"))
  
  UA_blocks <- st_join(blocks, UAs, join = st_covered_by)
  
  UA_pops <- UA_blocks %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    group_by(FID) %>%
    summarise(UA_pop = sum(tot_pop)) %>%
    na.omit() %>%
    right_join(UAs) %>%
    st_as_sf()
  
  county_UAs <- st_intersects(us_counties, st_transform(UA_pops, st_crs(us_counties)))
  county_UAs_max_pop <- unlist(lapply(county_UAs, function(x) {
    if(length(x) == 0) {
      return_val <- NA
    } else {
      pops <- st_drop_geometry(UA_pops[x, "UA_pop"])
      return_val <- max(pops)
    }
    return(return_val)
  }))
  
  us_counties$max_urb_pop <- county_UAs_max_pop
  
  county_UAs_labels <- us_counties %>%
    mutate(urb_label = ifelse(!(GEOID %in% near_counties$GEOID), ">150 mi commute", NA)) %>%
    mutate(urb_label = ifelse(max_urb_pop >= 50000 & !is.na(max_urb_pop), "Metropolitan", urb_label)) %>%
    mutate(urb_label = ifelse(max_urb_pop >= 10000 & max_urb_pop < 50000 & !is.na(max_urb_pop), "Micropolitan", urb_label)) %>%
    mutate(urb_label = ifelse(max_urb_pop >= 5000 & max_urb_pop < 10000 & !is.na(max_urb_pop), "Small town", urb_label)) %>%
    mutate(urb_label = ifelse(is.na(urb_label), "Rural", urb_label))
  
  return(county_UAs_labels)
}, blocks = block_data_list, year = years, SIMPLIFY = FALSE)



# get commuting flows
commutes_1990 <- read.table("https://www2.census.gov/programs-surveys/commuting/datasets/1990/worker-flow/idresco.txt",
                                   sep = "\t", strip.white = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(allinfo = str_squish(V1),
         ResFIPS = str_replace_all(str_sub(allinfo, 1, 6), " ", ""),
         WorkFIPS = str_replace_all(str_sub(allinfo, 14, 19), " ", ""),
         Workers = as.integer(str_extract(str_extract(allinfo, " \\d+ [A-Z]"), "\\d+"))) %>%
  left_join(st_drop_geometry(counties_urb[[1]])[,c("GEOID", "NAME", "urb_label", "max_urb_pop")], by = c("ResFIPS" = "GEOID")) %>%
  rename("ResUrbStatus" = "urb_label",
         "ResUrbPop" = "max_urb_pop",
         "county" = "NAME") %>%
  left_join(st_drop_geometry(counties_urb[[1]])[,c("GEOID", "urb_label", "max_urb_pop")], by = c("WorkFIPS" = "GEOID")) %>%
  rename("WorkUrbStatus" = "urb_label",
         "WorkUrbPop" = "max_urb_pop") %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(WorkUrbStatus = ifelse(is.na(WorkUrbStatus), ">150 mi commute", WorkUrbStatus),
         commute = ifelse(ResFIPS == WorkFIPS, 
                          paste(ResUrbStatus, "Stay", sep="_"),
                          ifelse(ResUrbStatus == "Metropolitan" & WorkUrbStatus == "Metropolitan",
                                 ifelse(WorkUrbPop > ResUrbPop, 
                                        "Metropolitan_BiggerMetropolitan",
                                        "Metropolitan_SmallerMetropolitan"),
                                 paste(ResUrbStatus, WorkUrbStatus, sep="_"))
                          ),
         year = 1990) %>%
  group_by(county, year, commute) %>%
  summarise(workers = sum(Workers))

commutes_2000 <- readxl::read_xls("../data/raw_data/2kresco_id.xls",
                                  range = "A5:K1388") %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(ResFIPS = paste0(`Res State`, `Res County`),
         WorkFIPS = paste0(str_sub(`Work State`, 2,3), `Work County`)) %>%
  left_join(st_drop_geometry(counties_urb[[2]])[,c("GEOID", "NAME", "urb_label", "max_urb_pop")], by = c("ResFIPS" = "GEOID")) %>%
  rename("ResUrbStatus" = "urb_label",
         "ResUrbPop" = "max_urb_pop",
         "county" = "NAME") %>%
  left_join(st_drop_geometry(counties_urb[[2]])[,c("GEOID", "urb_label", "max_urb_pop")], by = c("WorkFIPS" = "GEOID")) %>%
  rename("WorkUrbStatus" = "urb_label",
         "WorkUrbPop" = "max_urb_pop") %>%
  mutate(WorkUrbStatus = ifelse(is.na(WorkUrbStatus), ">150 mi commute", WorkUrbStatus),
         commute = ifelse(ResFIPS == WorkFIPS, 
                          paste(ResUrbStatus, "Stay", sep="_"),
                          ifelse(ResUrbStatus == "Metropolitan" & WorkUrbStatus == "Metropolitan",
                                 ifelse(WorkUrbPop > ResUrbPop, 
                                        "Metropolitan_BiggerMetropolitan",
                                        "Metropolitan_SmallerMetropolitan"),
                                 paste(ResUrbStatus, WorkUrbStatus, sep="_"))
                          ),
         year = 2000) %>%
  group_by(county, year, commute) %>%
  summarise(workers = sum(Count))

commutes_2010 <- readxl::read_xlsx("../data/raw_data/table1 (2010).xlsx",
                                  range = "A6:J26342",
                                  col_names = c("Res_State_FIPS", "Res_County_FIPS", "Work_State_FIPS", "Work_County_FIPS", "Workers", "MOE", "Res_State", "Res_County", "Work_State", "Work_County")) %>%
  filter(Res_State == "Idaho") %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(ResFIPS = paste0(Res_State_FIPS, Res_County_FIPS),
         WorkFIPS = paste0(str_sub(Work_State_FIPS, 2,3), Work_County_FIPS)) %>%
  left_join(st_drop_geometry(counties_urb[[3]])[,c("GEOID", "NAME", "urb_label", "max_urb_pop")], by = c("ResFIPS" = "GEOID")) %>%
  rename("ResUrbStatus" = "urb_label",
         "ResUrbPop" = "max_urb_pop",
         "county" = "NAME") %>%
  left_join(st_drop_geometry(counties_urb[[3]])[,c("GEOID", "urb_label", "max_urb_pop")], by = c("WorkFIPS" = "GEOID")) %>%
  rename("WorkUrbStatus" = "urb_label",
         "WorkUrbPop" = "max_urb_pop") %>%
  mutate(WorkUrbStatus = ifelse(is.na(WorkUrbStatus), ">150 mi commute", WorkUrbStatus),
         commute = ifelse(ResFIPS == WorkFIPS, 
                          paste(ResUrbStatus, "Stay", sep="_"),
                          ifelse(ResUrbStatus == "Metropolitan" & WorkUrbStatus == "Metropolitan",
                                 ifelse(WorkUrbPop > ResUrbPop, 
                                        "Metropolitan_BiggerMetropolitan",
                                        "Metropolitan_SmallerMetropolitan"),
                                 paste(ResUrbStatus, WorkUrbStatus, sep="_"))
                          ),
         year = 2010) %>%
  group_by(county, year, commute) %>%
  summarise(workers = sum(Workers))

commutes_2020 <- readxl::read_xlsx("../data/raw_data/table1 (2020).xlsx",
                                  range = "A9:J23788",
                                  col_names = c("Res_State_FIPS", "Res_County_FIPS", "Res_State", "Res_County", "Work_State_FIPS", "Work_County_FIPS", "Work_State", "Work_County", "Workers", "MOE" )) %>%
  filter(Res_State == "Idaho") %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(ResFIPS = paste0(Res_State_FIPS, Res_County_FIPS),
         WorkFIPS = paste0(str_sub(Work_State_FIPS, 2,3), Work_County_FIPS)) %>%
  left_join(st_drop_geometry(counties_urb[[4]])[,c("GEOID", "NAME", "urb_label", "max_urb_pop")], by = c("ResFIPS" = "GEOID")) %>%
  rename("ResUrbStatus" = "urb_label",
         "ResUrbPop" = "max_urb_pop",
         "county" = "NAME") %>%
  left_join(st_drop_geometry(counties_urb[[4]])[,c("GEOID", "urb_label", "max_urb_pop")], by = c("WorkFIPS" = "GEOID")) %>%
  rename("WorkUrbStatus" = "urb_label",
         "WorkUrbPop" = "max_urb_pop") %>%
  mutate(WorkUrbStatus = ifelse(is.na(WorkUrbStatus), ">150 mi commute", WorkUrbStatus),
         commute = ifelse(ResFIPS == WorkFIPS, 
                          paste(ResUrbStatus, "Stay", sep="_"),
                          ifelse(ResUrbStatus == "Metropolitan" & WorkUrbStatus == "Metropolitan",
                                 ifelse(WorkUrbPop > ResUrbPop, 
                                        "Metropolitan_BiggerMetropolitan",
                                        "Metropolitan_SmallerMetropolitan"),
                                 paste(ResUrbStatus, WorkUrbStatus, sep="_"))
                          ),
         year = 2020) %>%
  group_by(county, year, commute) %>%
  summarise(workers = sum(Workers))

commutes_all <- do.call(rbind, list(commutes_1990, commutes_2000, commutes_2010, commutes_2020)) %>%
  group_by(county, year) %>%
  mutate(tot_workers = sum(workers)) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(perc_workers = workers / tot_workers * 100) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c("county", "year"),
              names_from = "commute",
              values_from = "perc_workers",
              values_fill = 0)

ruca_proxy_pca <- prcomp(commutes_all[,-c(1:2)])

# PCs 1-2 explain ~80% of variance
a_data <- cbind(commutes_all[,c(1:2)], ruca_proxy_pca$x[,c(1:2)]) %>%
  rename("ruca_proxy_pc1" = "PC1",
         "ruca_proxy_pc2" = "PC2") %>%
  right_join(a_data, by = c("county", "year"))
```
